visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man and a woman sit together on a grey fabric couch in a modern, well-lit living room. The man is wearing a black t-shirt and looking at his phone. The woman, dressed in a grey long-sleeved crop top and black skirt, holds a silver microphone and sings energetically, pointing at the man and his phone. The background includes a white door, a mirror, and a kitchen area with a black range hood. (2) The visual transitions through several jump cuts as the woman continues her performance. She uses exaggerated hand gestures and facial expressions to convey accusation and suspicion, while the man appears defensive or annoyed, occasionally covering his face or gesturing with his hands. (3) The woman holds out her hand for the phone, and the man hands it over. She looks at the screen, which shows a FaceTime call with an older woman. She smiles broadly and waves at the phone. The man looks at her with a confused expression as she stands up and exits the frame.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain the audience with a relatable and humorous parody of a jealous partner trope. The video builds tension through the woman's accusing singing, which is then subverted by the reveal that the man was simply on a video call with his mother.
